title: Governor of Tamil Nadu meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Governor of Tamil Nadu, Shri Rajendra Arlekar met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi. The Prime Minister’s Office wrote on X; “Governor of Tamil Nadu, Shri @rajendraarlekar met Prime Minister @narendramodi. @lokbhavan_tn” Governor of Tamil Nadu, Shri @rajendraarlekar met Prime Minister @narendramodi.

@lokbhavan_tn https://t.co/IaepCRcUrw — PMO India (@PMOIndia) November 6, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/ST
